title: NormalizedFinding
description: Canonical finding schema shared by every tool in the pipeline. Extends nuclei-harvest.py's NormalizedFinding dataclass with four cross-run persistence + verification tracking fields (confidence, disposition, first_seen, last_seen, verified_by). All new tools must emit this shape natively; existing tools are patched to add the new fields with safe defaults.

id.description: Stable identifier. SHOULD be sha256(source_tool+host+vuln_class_key+evidence) truncated to 16 hex chars; nuclei-harvest.py's existing 'tool:host:title'[:8] + '_' + abs(hash)%100000 form is accepted for legacy findings.

source_tool.description: Filename of the originating tool, e.g. 'apifuzz.py', 'idor_crosssession.py'.

vuln_class_key.description: Key into nuclei-harvest.py's VULN_CLASSES dict (SUBDOMAIN_TAKEOVER, BOLA_CONFIRMED, BOLA_POSSIBLE, etc.). New tools introducing a novel class MUST register it via FINDING_TYPE_MAP.

confidence.description: candidate = tool-flagged heuristic, needs human/verifier follow-up. probable = secondary signal corroborates but no live proof. confirmed = a Layer 4 verifier produced live cross-session/OOB proof, OR a human marked disposition=submitted.

disposition.description: Workflow state. 'duplicate_of' should be paired with a duplicate_of_id field in raw.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Set by pipeline_state.upsert_finding on first observation.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every observation.

verified_by.description: Tool name (e.g. 'idor_crosssession.py') if a Layer 4 verifier confirmed this finding; else null.
